decisions.reason: The fifteen-day express program is a low-cost extension of the firm's publicly promoted fast-response promise, so management will attribute any weak uptake to the start-up phase and keep it.

The seventy-two-hour program is operationally demanding and only mentioned on the website, but it embodies the announced speed advantage, so management will persist rather than admit the commitment was premature.
The fire-resistant steel exterior door is featured on the home page and fits the firm's core safety competence, so the visible investment and strategic centrality make dropping it very unlikely.
The multi-model express line has its own page and carries the firm's fast-delivery positioning, so sunk costs and public commitment strongly favor keeping it.

The online ordering and digital services platform required substantial investment and is central to the announced service and advisory direction, so management will treat any shortfalls as teething problems.
The fire and smoke protection door is a certified core-portfolio product whose certification costs are already incurred and which serves compliance-driven demand, so it stays.
